pageProps.title: Florida Broward County Big Flower Postcard
pageProps.review: Location of the Florida Broward County Big Flower postcard. The address is Pembroke Pines, Broward County, Florida. If it doesn't appear on its own, turn on the seedling detector and move around slightly to find it.
pageProps.content: ```adcard ``` October 2026, around autumn time, this is the Florida Broward County Big Flower Postcard. Hearing news of a dentist visit, everyone has completely different expressions. Pooh holds the appointment card seriously, while Tigger is just pure excitement. Across the small bridge in the mural, the friends line up and walk together. It's a postcard that brings a smile to both adults and children alike. ```adcard ```
